findings.current: A liquor bottle struck Hyuk Mujin squarely in the back of the head. His skull cracked open, and the cheap bottle shattered into fragments that flew in every direction.
findings.defect: The draft turns the colloquial description of Hyuk Mujin getting cracked over the head into a literal open-skull injury, contradicting his immediately continuing to argue.
findings.rationale: 뚝배기가 깨져 나가고 is comic slang for taking a hard blow to the head here, not a statement that his skull was physically split open.
findings.replacement: A liquor bottle struck Hyuk Mujin squarely in the back of the head, cracking him over the skull. The cheap bottle shattered, sending fragments flying in every direction.
findings.source: 정확히 뒤통수를 강타한 술병에 혁무진의 뚝배기가 깨져 나가고, 싸구려 술병이 산산 조각나며 사방으로 튀었다.

findings.current: “You bastards I couldn’t kill enough to satisfy myself! How dare you raise hell in a place like this!”
findings.defect: The first insult is ungrammatical and changes the source's hypothetical threat into a claim about repeatedly killing them.
findings.rationale: 찢어 죽여도 시원치 않을 means that even tearing them apart and killing them would not satisfy his anger.
findings.replacement: “You bastards! Even tearing you apart wouldn’t satisfy me! How dare you cause trouble here!”
findings.source: “이 찢어 죽여도 시원치 않을 놈들! 예가 어디라고 감히 행패를 부리냐!”

findings.current: “No, fuck! What did you do with the silver nyang I gave you earlier? Boil soup with it?”
findings.defect: The draft invents the denomination “nyang”; the source only says 은전, a silver coin.
findings.rationale: 은전 identifies the payment as a silver coin without specifying a nyang denomination.
findings.replacement: “No, fuck! What did you do with the silver coin I gave you earlier? Boil soup with it?”
findings.source: “아니, 씨바. 아까 줬던 은전은 국 끓여 먹었소!”

findings.current: The Fire Dragon Pavilion members rushed out of the Poison Flower Pavilion with me at the front. Waiting outside was a crowd that had grown to nearly a hundred people.
findings.defect: The draft changes the stated crowd size from one hundred to fewer than one hundred.
findings.rationale: 백 명으로 불어난 gives the resulting number as one hundred, not nearly one hundred.
findings.replacement: The Fire Dragon Pavilion members rushed out of the Poison Flower Pavilion with me at the front. Waiting outside was a crowd that had grown to a hundred people.
findings.source: 나를 필두로 독화루를 빠져나간 화룡각 대원들을 기다리고 있던 것은 어느덧 백 명으로 불어난 인파였다.

findings.current: “So you killed our parents, who are alive and well?”
findings.defect: Hyuk Mujin refers to his own parents, but the draft changes the possessive to the group’s collective parents.
findings.rationale: 저희 부모님 is Hyuk Mujin’s deferential reference to his own parents; 죽인 겁니까 jokingly accuses Namho of declaring them dead by calling him motherless and fatherless.
findings.replacement: “So you killed off my parents when they’re both alive and well?”
findings.source: “그래서 멀쩡히 살아 계신 저희 부모님을 죽인 겁니까?”

findings.current:
Namho, too, had continued his work without forgetting his duty.

Nanho smiled bitterly at Ju Hwaran’s exclamation.
findings.defect: Ju Hwaran’s entire expression of admiration and concern is omitted, leaving an exclamation that never appears; Namho’s name is also misspelled.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly preserves Ju Hwaran’s recognition of the dangers Namho faced and his decades of hardship before describing his bitter reaction.
findings.replacement:
Namho, too, had continued his work without forgetting his duty.

“Nanman is full of treacherous terrain, predators, and venomous beasts. It couldn’t have been easy… You must have gone through a great deal.”

Namho’s expression turned bitter at Ju Hwaran’s exclamation.
findings.source:
“남만은 험지와 맹수, 독물로 가득한 땅이라 쉽지 않았을 텐데…… 정말 고생 많으셨겠군요.”

주화란의 탄성에 남호가 씁쓸한 표정을 지었다.

findings.current: *Half a shichen from now. Meet me by the lakeside ten li away.*
findings.defect: The traditional time and distance units are retained without the brief factual explanation needed for an English reader to understand the rendezvous.
findings.rationale: The rendezvous is in roughly one hour at a lake roughly five kilometers away; a concise footnote preserves the source units while making their practical meaning clear.
findings.replacement:
*Half a shichen[^1] from now. Meet me by the lakeside ten li away.*

[^1]: A shichen is approximately two hours, while ten li is approximately five kilometers.
findings.source: ‘반 시진 뒤. 십 리 밖에 있는 호숫가에서 보세.’

summary: The draft contains a critical injury escalation, a substantial omitted line, an altered kinship reference, and several localized fidelity and terminology issues.
